name: autonomous-ai-researcher-landing
description: Static landing page for Autonomous AI Researcher

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['index.html','404.html']) { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.writeFileSync(f, fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace(/styles\.css/g,'styles.min.css')); }"
